metadata.description: Marine restricted boundaries for ORCA's Geospatial Reasoning Agent. IMBL segments are simplified digitizations of coordinates published in bilateral maritime boundary agreements (India-Sri Lanka 1974/1976; India-Pakistan 1968 Sir Creek/seaward extension). MPA polygons are simplified outer-buffer approximations of officially notified protected areas. Coordinates are adequate for hackathon-grade geofence demos; verify against official survey charts before any production or navigational use.
metadata.disclaimer: NOT FOR NAVIGATION. Simplified geometry; nearest-boundary distances are approximate.

properties.name: India-Sri Lanka IMBL (Palk Strait segment)
properties.treaty_reference: Agreement between India and Sri Lanka on the Maritime Boundary between the two countries in the Palk Strait and adjacent areas, Colombo, 26 June 1974

properties.treaty_reference: Agreement between India and Sri Lanka on the Maritime Boundary in the Gulf of Mannar and Bay of Bengal, Colombo, 23 March 1976
